description: Discovers or configures reviewed v2 setup for a site. With only a URL it is read-only, needs no Pixel and returns setup guidance. With a real Pixel ID on a connected project, it saves the project's site URL and Pixel ID; switching an existing Pixel or site requires confirm_change. Does not approve, install or activate tracking.

checkout_domains.description: hostnames where checkout happens, if already known

confirm_change.description: true = yes, switch this project to a different Pixel ID or site URL on purpose

name.description: project name; defaults to the site name

pixel_id.description: Meta Pixel ID, numeric; optional while it is not yet known

url.description: the site being tracked: a domain or full URL

name: setup_tracking
title: Discover or configure site
